_comment: How a vehicle drives (VehicleMotion): every number has a light end (weight 0, a small tractor) and a heavy end (weight 1, the Combine); a vehicle's own weight in the catalog picks the point between. Speeds are in tiles per second, springs in radians per second. A heavy machine is slower to start and stop, rides on softer springs that sink deeper and settle later, turns later and throws up more dust.
